name: rosbag2_go2_map_benchmark02
description: A robotics dataset composed of rosbag2 recordings intended to benchmark mapping and localization (SLAM) pipelines. It contains sensor streams (e.g., odometry, cameras, LiDAR) recorded for mapping scenarios and is used to evaluate mapping accuracy, trajectory reconstruction and localization robustness. Suitable for testing SLAM algorithms and map-building components in simulated or real-world runs.
reputation: A specialized robotics/SLAM dataset from UniflexAI with limited adoption outside robotics research and specific toolchains.
